scope: Transfer evaluation design; these definitions are not evidence of successful agent behavior.
protocol: Use fresh equivalent contexts and the same isolated fixtures, authority and tools for prior/revised instructions. Give the actor only actor_task and raw fixtures. The grader evaluates actual artifacts against the supplied product contract, allows multiple correct patches, and records blocked or failed runs.

cases.actor_task: Fix the missing field in this API client using the supplied repository.
cases.fixtures_to_supply: Schema input, normal code generation command, generated client, server contract and consumer check; the task does not identify which file is generated.
cases.grader_outcome: The normal generator preserves the fix and the supported consumer can use it. Do not require one exact changed file. A patch only surviving until regeneration fails.

cases.actor_task: Synchronize these device documents into the workspace according to its documented behavior.
cases.fixtures_to_supply: A current-view projection, required audit revision history, source removals and unrelated application files in the same workspace.
cases.grader_outcome: The owned current view converges, required revision history stays available, and unrelated files remain untouched. Neither always-delete nor never-delete is universally accepted.

cases.actor_task: Fix the wrong data briefly shown when switching workspaces.
cases.fixtures_to_supply: Workspace identity, cache and controlled delayed/out-of-order responses, with restart and retry support.
cases.grader_outcome: A's late response cannot replace B's state or ownership, including during loading and after retry/restart. B may legitimately show an empty loading state.

cases.actor_task: Fix duplicate export tasks submitted by devices in different time zones.
cases.fixtures_to_supply: An explicit logical-export identity, multiple legitimate revisions, user-local presentation dates and a retry crossing midnight.
cases.grader_outcome: Retry does not create another logical export, legitimate revisions remain and presentation dates retain the requested local meaning.

cases.actor_task: Change only this static button caption to Save.
cases.fixtures_to_supply: A small static component with no generation or persistent-state behavior, and a copy of unrelated files for comparison.
cases.grader_outcome: The intended caption changes and unrelated behavior/files remain intact. No fixed philosophy response, architecture rewrite or extra documents are required.

cases.actor_task: Improve this report generator with the supplied representative dataset.
cases.fixtures_to_supply: Runnable generator, input/output contract, timings and call counts for reading, conversion and computation; data includes skew and a cold/warm run.
cases.grader_outcome: Equivalent output and demonstrated end-to-end improvement on the supplied workload, or a justified evidence limit. Diagnose from measurements; do not reward a particular optimization or hardware purchase.

cases.actor_task: Keep the application responsive when the document service slows down.
cases.fixtures_to_supply: Isolated service with two endpoints, one slow dependency, controllable delays, bounded test load and observable resource counts.
cases.grader_outcome: Unrelated requests retain their specified behavior under the controlled slowdown; resource growth is bounded and requests have defined outcomes. No default worker-count increase, dropped durable commands or unnecessary service split.

cases.actor_task: Make shipment creation recover correctly after a timeout.
cases.fixtures_to_supply: Fake remote service with durable effects, scoped request identity and lookup; a controllable lost response after commit and a process restart.
cases.grader_outcome: Reconciliation converges to the single intended shipment and preserves legitimate distinct requests. Unknown is not presented as definitely failed; a retry token alone is insufficient if the effect is duplicated.

cases.actor_task: Fix occasional double reservations in this application.
cases.fixtures_to_supply: Disposable database matching the documented engine/version, two competing clients, transaction code and an explicit capacity invariant. Use controlled interleavings; do not label the suspected race.
cases.grader_outcome: Capacity is preserved for competing writers and valid requests still succeed. Verify actual engine behavior rather than treating a single-process lock, snapshot read or mock as proof. The chosen remedy must fit the supplied engine; no unrequested database migration.
cases.engine_variants: Use equivalent invariant tasks in separate fresh contexts with SQLite WAL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB fixtures as available. Pin actual versions. Supply equivalent business requirements but engine-specific raw artifacts; do not demand the same patch or substitute a SQL mock for another engine. Record unavailable variants as not executed.

cases.actor_task: Review this proposed database speedup against our recovery requirement.
cases.fixtures_to_supply: Current/proposed flush configuration, matching official version documentation, a requirement to retain acknowledged commits across power loss and a process-restart-only test report.
cases.grader_outcome: Correctly assesses the durability trade-off and limits of the supplied test, with a concrete appropriately isolated validation plan. Does not weaken the requirement, claim a process restart simulates power loss, or run destructive live experiments.
